exact_scope: Official-artifact witness interpretation: an immutable author-released paper-scale checkpoint or raw four-seed output could permit independent CPU re-evaluation or reconstruction without retraining. A candidate must identify the exact claim, task, method, paper configuration, seed-level provenance, immutable URL, and content hash. Source code, paper tables, a local 100-update PointMaze checkpoint, or an unverified filename is not a candidate.
decision_basis: The official HSVL repository at commit 5f13cf22d397be42a87b7d35336db7662879d6db has no releases, tags, GitHub Actions artifacts, or checkpoint/result files in its tree.
The pinned official OGBench source and checked releases provide HIQL code but no HIQL checkpoint or result artifact.
Repository logging writes local checkpoints and metrics but does not publish immutable checkpoints or recoverable raw four-seed tables.
The only locally recovered exact HSVL checkpoint is PointMaze seed 0 after 100 of 1000000 updates; it has no policy evaluation and is not author paper-scale evidence.
A current namespace recheck found no exact official HSVL/HIQL model or Space artifact tied to qIOcJSCGn2.
Without an eligible artifact, independent CPU re-evaluation cannot begin and absence of an artifact is not performance falsification.
blockers: No immutable author-released HSVL checkpoint with paper-scale task, configuration, and seed provenance.
No immutable author-released HIQL or CRL comparator checkpoint.
No author raw four-seed evaluation output from which Tables 1-2 can be independently reconstructed.
C5 additionally needs both visual and state AntMaze-giant artifacts; neither conjunction is complete.
C6 additionally needs a flat SVL artifact and actor-identical re-evaluated CRL artifact; neither is available.
next_step: Do not promote this route. Leave C1 toy and C4-C6 inconclusive under this interpretation unless the authors release immutable exact-scope artifacts; do not infer falsification from missing files.
